SidecarFile.description: Sidecar file content — structurally identical to `FileContent`; sidecars are merged into the main context during parsing, so a specification can be modular.

name.description: The file's name (`properties.ctxdsl`); provenance only, the content is what is parsed.

TemplateRef.description:
A concrete template reference (template ID + bound arguments).

Used in `.espec.json`, `.mununu.json`, XState `__mununu`, CLI, and API requests as an alternative to a raw formula string.

description: Request for context verification (formula evaluation) — the body of `POST /api/v1/context/eval` and the input of the MCP `context_eval` tool (one shape, two surfaces; the schema is `docs/api-schemas/context-eval-request.schema.json`).

automaton.description: The automaton to evaluate against. If omitted (`null`), each formula's declared target automaton(s).

context.description: The main CTXDSL file: its name and its full text. Sources come inline, never as a path the server opens.

counterstrategy.description: When true, compute the environment's counterstrategy for each violated formula, via formula inversion. Defaults to `false`.

formula.description: Evaluate one formula by name. If omitted (`null`), evaluate ALL user-defined formulas of the context. Mutually exclusive with `template_ref`.

hide.description: Labels to hide (reclassified as internal) before evaluation. Defaults to `[]`. NOT SUPPORTED by `POST /api/v1/context/eval` (and the MCP tool `context_eval`): a non-empty list is refused with a 400 naming it (mununu#862; it used to be accepted and ignored).

minimize.description: When true, apply bisimulation minimization before evaluation. Defaults to `false`. NOT SUPPORTED by `POST /api/v1/context/eval` (and the MCP tool `context_eval`): `true` is refused with a 400 naming it (mununu#862; it used to be accepted and ignored).

minimize_counterstrategy.description: When true and `counterstrategy` is set, minimize the counterstrategy automaton by bisimulation. Defaults to `false`.

sanity.description: Run the structural checks (`context eval --sanity`) on `automaton`, or on every automaton the evaluated formulas target: deadlocks with a path, unreachable states, labels that never fire, internal livelocks.

sidecars.description: Sidecar CTXDSL files merged into the main context during parsing. Defaults to `[]`.

stubs.description: Stub `.espec.json` contents composed as sidecars (interface automata). Defaults to `[]`. NOT SUPPORTED by `POST /api/v1/context/eval` (and the MCP tool `context_eval`): a non-empty list is refused with a 400 naming it (mununu#862; it used to be accepted and ignored).

template_ref.description: A property template to instantiate instead of selecting an existing formula — `{"template": "no_deadlock"}` or `{"template": "reachable", "args": {"TARGET": "…"}}`; the catalogue is `GET /api/v1/templates` / the MCP `templates` tool. Mutually exclusive with `formula`.

title: ContextVerifyRequest
